notes_for_editor: One register entry plus one hobby site. The hobby page's 1933 bulletin quote names a 'Bald Rock Lookout Station' and a lookout, Fred Whitlock; it does not name Ball Rock, so it is not used. A separate NHLR entry, Ball Mountain Lookout, is a different site and should not be merged with this record. No new photos with image URLs were read.
